name: skills
description: Get production-ready images, video, audio, and 3D from any AI agent: skills that pick the right model, price before spending, and keep characters and brands consistent through the Scenario MCP, plus expert teams that drive Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, and Unity.
one_liner: Plugs into your AI assistant so it can generate on-brand images, video, audio, and 3D models that actually look consistent from one asset to the next, and warns you the price before it spends your money.
buyer: A small marketing agency or indie game studio that needs a steady stream of branded visual assets but can't afford a full in-house art team.
business_use_cases: A boutique game-asset studio offers indie game developers AI-assisted concept art, 3D props, and animation with a consistent visual style across a whole project.
An ad agency produces a month's worth of on-brand social media visuals for small-business clients, keeping the same product/character look across every post.
A real-estate or architecture firm generates consistent-style 3D renders and walkthrough visuals for property listings without hiring a 3D artist.

money_ideas.idea: Monthly subscription delivering a fixed batch of on-brand visual assets to small-business or agency clients.
Per-project one-off fee for a complete branded asset pack (logo variants, social templates, product renders).

steal_this: This weekend, pick one local business, generate a month's worth of consistent, on-brand social media visuals with this toolkit, and pitch it to them as a $300/month 'AI content studio' retainer.
